New 'Ghost in the Shell' TV Anime Announces Main Cast
The official website for the new Koukaku Kidoutai (The Ghost in the Shell) television anime announced the main cast on Tuesday. The new TV anime premiered on Tuesday at 11:00 p.m. on Kansai TV and Fuji TV affiliates. Manga '7-nin no Nemurihime' Gets TV Anime in 2027
Production company Avex Pictures opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Lee Fiok's 7-nin no Nemurihime (Seven Sleeping Beauties) manga on Tuesday, revealing the main cast, staff, and a super teaser visual (pictured right). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027. Cast Flora: Aya Yamane (Megami no Café Terrace) Chiara: Yoshino Aoyama (Bocchi the Rock!) 'Sword Art Online' Original Movie Announces Main Staff, 2028 Premiere
The official website for the Sword Art Online anime series revealed on Tuesday the main staff, official title, teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser trailer for the previously announced original anime movie. The movie, titled Integral Domaine, is scheduled to open in theaters in 2028. Voice actors Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu return as Kazuto Kirigaya and Asuna Yuuki, respectively.
